title: fix(types): declare `title` on ObjectGridSchema's zod mirror (census-directed declare branch)
body:
Fixes #6639

Executes the census-directed maintainer ruling of 2026-08-29 (both branches pre-authorized, census decides). The census came back non-zero, so this is the **declare** branch: `title` lands on `ObjectGridSchema` in the #6424 family form — interface + zod mirror + `zod-mirror-parity` pairing.

## The census (ruling step 1 — recorded here as the ruling requires)

Parse-based and order-agnostic (exact JSON parse for `.json` files; balanced-brace node extraction with depth-1 sibling keys for docs/code), run on base `30266cf` over `apps/`, `examples/`, `content/`:

| reading | count |
|---|---|
| files containing `object-grid` nodes | 11 |
| `object-grid` nodes total | 32 |
| nodes authoring a sibling `title` | **2** |
| positive control, same instrument (`label`) | 2 (non-zero — instrument alive) |

**Per-hit confirmation (the triage-mandated step):** both hits are genuine `title` keys at depth 1 of an `object-grid` node — not nested-object misattribution — in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`: the canonical ObjectGridSchema reference example (authors `title: "All Contacts"`, and the section's own property table documents `title`) and the full-page example (`title: "All Leads"` directly beside `type: "object-grid"`). The prior census's proximity-heuristic "2" is thereby CONFIRMED, not merely inherited; an order-agnostic re-sweep (which the original single-line regex could not do — it also returns zero via plain grep on today's base because the doc examples are multi-line) found no additional hits and no title-before-type case.

Authors exist ⇒ **declare**. Dropping the read would have silently cost those authored nodes their caption — under this reading "drop" was the destructive option, exactly as triage warned.

⚠️ **Unmeasured, inherited as such:** only `apps/`, `examples/`, `content/` were scanned, per the card's own scope. External consumers and customer projects were NOT; the real authoring population can only be larger than these readings, never smaller. The census bounds this repo, not the world.

## Premise correction (measured, with the receipt)

The card states "`ObjectGridSchema` declares **no** `title`. The read compiles only because `BaseSchema`'s index signature makes every key a member." That is **half false, and was false when the card was filed**: at `5ef9c4f5f` (the last `objectql.ts`-touching commit before filing), the interface already declared `title?: string` (`@deprecated Use label instead`, in the LEGACY FIELDS block) — so both read sites compile through a declared member, not through the index signature. What genuinely was missing is the **zod-mirror half** of the family form: the published validator had never heard of the key, recorded as debt in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`'s `UnmirroredDeclared` ledger. The spec side (`ComponentPropsMap` for object-grid) declares `title` too, and the #4648 ruling already carved it out of the published `inputs` as a deprecated alias — the zod mirror was the one face out of lockstep. This PR closes exactly that face.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` — the mirror declares `title: z.string().optional()` with the deprecation-pointing describe text. The gain is the **typed refusal**: the `.passthrough()` base was already admitting ANY `title` unexamined; the mirror now enforces the declared string.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` — `title` leaves the `UnmirroredDeclared` entry for the pair (the ledger's first shrink by REPAIR rather than reclassification), and every count the header quotes is corrected: 97 is the mirroring debt; 97 + 1 mirrored + 23 reclassified is what the seeded "121" now means.
- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` — doc-comment only: the interface's existing `title` declaration now cites the ruling, the census, and the mirror pairing. No type change.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-grid-title-mirrored.test.ts` — new pin: shape membership (membership cannot be read off acceptance under passthrough), authored-string survival through the parse, typed refusal pointed at the `title` path, and the before-state kept as a labelled control (an undeclared key of the wrong type is still admitted unexamined — which is what `title: 123` did before this change).
- `.changeset/6639-objectgrid-title-mirrored.md` — minor, `@object-ui/types` (same bump the #6424 declarations used).

**Both read sites, same batch (the triage constraint):** re-derived on this base, they are `ObjectGrid.tsx:2510` (`viewLabel`) and `:3524` (`caption`), both spelled `schema.label || schema.title`. Under the declare branch both stay as-is — they are now reads of a key declared on every face — and they cannot diverge because neither is touched. #6269 stays out of scope: `BaseSchema`'s index signature is untouched here, and no other key is declared as a rider.

## The framing that must survive (triage ruled it must not be lost)

This card is the **terminal case** of a rule the lane tracked from three directions: a pin enforced by a key's non-membership stops enforcing when the key becomes a member (#6626); a refusal derived from a key's membership stops enforcing when the member is deleted (#6625); and **with an index signature there is no non-membership to enforce with, ever**. This is not one key's problem — `BaseSchema`'s index signature costs the whole authoring surface its authoring-time checking. This PR repairs one key's validator face under that standing condition; the index signature itself is #6269's scope and remains open.

## Verification (union re-run at the final commit, `8d5629d`)

- `@object-ui/types` `type-check` (three tsc passes incl. `tsconfig.test.json`, which carries the compile-time parity assertions): exit 0. New test file confirmed INSIDE the compilation via `tsc --listFiles` (the excluded-tests trap checked, not assumed).
- All `packages/types` tests: 73 files, 844 tests passed.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` `type-check` (after rebuilding the types dist): exit 0; `gridNonAuthorKeys` + `gridDataInputContract`: 50 passed.
- Gates for the touched paths: `check:control-bytes` OK (5724 files), `check:spec-symbols` OK, `eslint` on `packages/types` 0 errors.
- **Ablation (committed-first, trap-restored, disk-confirmed):** deleting the mirror's `title` line (anchor count 1 to 0 on disk, diff names the file) turned exactly the predicted halves red — membership + typed-refusal tests failed while acceptance/survival stayed green (the passthrough vacuity the membership assertion exists for), and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` failed naming the exact pair (`Type '"objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'`). Restore proven by empty `git diff HEAD` and matching blob hash (`a2b18b46…` on both sides); both instruments green after restore. No dist in the loop: both instruments compile and run package-relative source.
- Declared narrowing: the downstream consumer sweep was narrowed to `plugin-grid` (the read-site consumer). The diff is an additive optional key on one zod object plus doc comments — no consumer's accept set narrows. Runtime consumers of `objectql.zod` outside the types package (`plugin-view`, `core/normalize-list-view`) were read and neither iterates this schema's shape. CI runs the full farm.

Census instrument accuracy note filed separately (see the issue's report comment) rather than fixed here.
